solved_invariants: Every offer now has a source-condition index preserving source URL, observation time, geography, fulfillment, eligibility, fact boundary, package-measure basis, and no availability assertion.
All 11 recipe links are explicitly partial source-bound ingredient coverages; zero complete recipe baskets were produced.
Average-weight H-E-B items preserve unit compatibility while refusing exact package/leftover claims.
body.summary: Produced refreshed deal-graph.json and basket-options.json from 67 current offers and 2,923 FFTS recipes. Outputs preserve exact source conditions, use normalized source-contained ingredient names plus explicit unit compatibility, model leftovers without inferring waste, and refuse complete-meal or availability claims.

tests.command: python3 -m json.tool deal-graph.json && python3 -m json.tool basket-options.json
tests.result: both artifacts parse; audit confirmed 67 offers, 20,875 component baskets, 11 partial coverages, 158 graph edges
